I2S_DOUT runs 0.13 mm from I2S_BCLK for 47 mm on B.Cu of a 2-layer board (the plane is 1.5 mm away), so their coupling saturates near 5% of a 3.3 V edge on the bit clock

/I2S_DOUT beside /I2S_BCLK (37 mm): sim_si puts 490 mV on the receiver with no driver declared (worst orientation), past the 165 mV budget, inside the 396 mV margin; with both nets driven from the one IC it still reads 256-377 mV, so it isn't the orientation
